messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated pod OOMs + eviction spike in eu-central-1 serving cluster. Impact: ~20% capacity reduction, client 5xx uptick. Alert: https://ops.redwood/incidents/1859001234
Sophia: I'm on triage. Alex fetch node metrics, Marina check routing options.
Alex: looking... `kubectl describe pod riff-rl-xyz` shows repeated OOMKills; kernel logs show nvidia module resets on 8 nodes.
Marina: can we shift traffic to eu-west-1? what's reserve there?
Ryan: we have ~25% burst capacity in eu-west reserved, Dedicated pools at 85% committed. We can shift up to 20% safely, cost will tick up.
Priya: runbook note: traffic-shift script exists: `scripts/traffic-shift.py --from eu-central --to eu-west --percent 30 --dry-run`. It currently does NOT check warm-pool. I will run dry-run.
Alex: node drain attempts are failing on two pods due to mount/unmount errors. suspect kernel nv-driver instability after a recent node-image rollout.
Sophia: stop further node-image rollouts in eu-central. Add immediate mitigation steps to runbook: (1) pause node-image upgrades in region (2) verify warm pool size > expected shift (3) traffic shift in 5% increments with 15m observation window (4) fallback to global degrade route after 60m if errors persist.
Marina: agreed. Also add a guard to routing service: don't move >10% if avg latency > SLO.
Priya: created dry-run ticket, results: script simulates shift but warns about warm-pool < threshold.
Ryan: cost note: estimated extra spend for 1h 20% shift -> ~$2.1k. Approve for incident mitigation?
Sophia: approve. Prioritize stability.
Alex: manual patch applied to nv driver on 4 affected nodes, they rejoined. Evictions dropped to ~5%.
Marina: starting controlled shift 10% to eu-west now.
Priya: shift started: `traffic-shift --percent 10` --- monitoring dashboards: errors hold steady.
Sophia: wait 15m.
(15m passes)
Marina: metrics look good, increase to 20%.
Alex: node pool health improving.
Sophia: moving to post-incident: action items:
- Sophia: Update failover runbook w/ warm-pool verification, step-by-step traffic-shift procedure, rollback thresholds, cost estimate section.
- Priya: Add dry-run validation to CI for traffic-shift script and gate on warm-pool check.
- Ryan: Provision an additional 10% burst buffer in EU Dedicated pools (ticket #OPS-7842).
- Alex: Rollback node-image rollout change and add driver sanity checks to node upgrade pipeline.
- Marina: Add latency guard to routing service (PR #3456) and create dashboard alert.
Sophia: I'd like a one-week follow-up runbook test: schedule a controlled failover dry-run across eu regions.
Priya: I'll schedule a chaos dry-run next Tue 12:00 UTC.
Sophia: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the postmortem and link the runbook PR. :white_check_mark:
